answer: Make every agent prove its uniqueness before it can earn by solving a sequential puzzle that cannot be split across copies, an umber-dark waiting room where each identity must spend real time before dawn breaks on its first paid job. A rotating beacon committee then spot-checks finished work by re-running a random sample, and any identity caught submitting another agent's output loses all its puzzle progress, so a thousand clones pay a thousand waiting times while an honest agent passes once.
